description: This file implements the NativeJSImplementation class, which provides methods for initializing, deinitializing, creating, running, and terminating JavaScript applications within a native rendering environment. It manages a renderer object, handles threading for initialization, and interacts with external components via method calls and shared pointers.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and operations of native JavaScript applications, including initialization, execution, and termination, within a plugin architecture.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::Initialize
methods.description: Starts the renderer in a separate thread, initializing it with the provided display string.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::Deinitialize
methods.description: Stops the renderer and joins the thread, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new JavaScript application with specified options and returns its ID.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::RunApplication
methods.description: Runs a specified application with a given URL.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within a specified application context.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current applications.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation::TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a specified application by ID.
